questions.q_en: Which statement correctly describes Class A fire?

Fire involving combustible solids such as wood, paper and fabric
A good fuel should be readily available and inexpensive

நல்ல எரிபொருள் எளிதில் கிடைக்கவும் மலிவாகவும் இருக்க வேண்டும்

questions.exp_en: Class B fire: Fire involving flammable liquids such as petrol, turpentine or paint.

questions.q_en: Which statement correctly describes Electrical fire?
